not: PM-063 deneme. Görseller GitHub Releases m1-gorsel-deneme varlığıdır; depoya girmez. PM gözle onaylamadan hat kurulmaz.

lx:Brot:2.de: Ich hätte gern ein halbes Brot, bitte.
lx:Brot:2.sahne_en: Inside a small Bavarian bakery, a baker behind the wooden counter holds up exactly one half of a round dark loaf, the cut side facing the customer, while the other half lies on the bread board; a middle-aged man in a winter jacket points at it. No text, no signs, no labels.

lx:Brot:3.de: Hol bitte noch Brot, wir haben keins mehr.
lx:Brot:3.sahne_en: In a modest apartment kitchen in the morning, a woman holds up an empty wicker bread basket with only a few crumbs in it toward a man who is putting on his jacket by the door. No text, no signs.

lx:Brot:6.de: – Ist das Brot von heute? – Ja, ganz frisch.
lx:Brot:6.sahne_en: At an outdoor weekly market stall on a town square in Bavaria, a female customer points at a stack of crusty loaves while the vendor proudly lifts one fresh loaf toward her, steam-warm and golden. No text, no signs, no price tags.

lx:Apfel:1.de: Die Äpfel hier kommen aus der Region.
lx:Apfel:1.sahne_en: At an outdoor farmers' market in a small Bavarian town, wooden crates overflowing with red and green apples stand on a stall, and the farmer in a plain fleece jacket hands one apple to a customer; rolling green hills are visible in the background. No text, no signs, no price tags.

lx:Apfel:2.de: Nehmen Sie doch einen Apfel für die Pause mit.
lx:Apfel:2.sahne_en: In a plain office kitchenette, an older woman holds out a bowl of apples to a younger colleague, who is taking one red apple from it. No text, no signs, no logos.

lx:Apfel:3.sahne_en: Two adult friends in casual clothes sit on a park bench in autumn, and one of them holds out a single red apple to the other with a friendly smile. No text, no signs.

lx:Käse:1.de: Ich hätte gern 200 Gramm Käse, bitte.
lx:Käse:1.sahne_en: At the cheese counter of a German supermarket, a sales assistant places a modest wedge of yellow cheese on an old-fashioned dial scale while a female customer watches from the other side of the glass counter. No text, no signs, no labels, no digits on the scale.

lx:Käse:3.de: Ich nehm das Brot mit Käse, ohne Wurst.
lx:Käse:3.sahne_en: At an outdoor snack stand on a Bavarian market square, a man points at one open sandwich topped with cheese slices, next to other sandwiches topped with sausage slices, and the vendor reaches for the cheese one. No text, no signs.

lx:Käse:5.de: Im Kühlschrank ist kein Käse mehr.
lx:Käse:5.sahne_en: In an apartment kitchen, a woman holds the fridge door open and looks with disappointment at an empty shelf where only an empty cheese wrapper lies, next to milk and vegetables on other shelves. No text, no labels, no logos.

lx:Semmel:1.sahne_en: Inside a traditional Bavarian bakery, a customer holds up two fingers while the baker places exactly two round crusty bread rolls into a small paper bag on the counter. No text, no signs, no logos.

lx:Semmel:4.de: – Mit Senf, in der Semmel? – Ja, gern.
lx:Semmel:4.sahne_en: At an outdoor sausage stand at a market in Bavaria, the vendor holds a grilled sausage tucked into a round crusty bread roll and squeezes mustard onto it, while a customer nods. No text, no signs, no logos.

lx:Semmel:5.de: Tobi isst jeden Morgen zwei Semmeln mit Butter.
lx:Semmel:5.sahne_en: At a breakfast table in a small apartment in the morning light, a young man sits with a plate holding exactly two halved round bread rolls spread with butter, a butter dish and a cup of coffee beside it. No text, no logos.

lx:Arzt:2.sahne_en: In a family doctor's consultation room, a middle-aged doctor in a light-blue shirt with a stethoscope around his neck hands a blank sheet of paper across his desk to a pale patient wrapped in a scarf. No text on the paper, no signs, no logos.

lx:Arzt:5.de: Dr. Weber ist ein sehr netter Arzt.
lx:Arzt:5.sahne_en: In the doorway of a consultation room in a small practice, a friendly grey-haired doctor in a plain shirt with a stethoscope around his neck smiles warmly and shakes hands with a female patient. No text, no signs, no name badges.

lx:Arzt:6.de: – Gibt es hier einen Arzt? – Ja, gleich da vorne.
lx:Arzt:6.sahne_en: On a quiet street of a Bavarian town, a man asks a woman passer-by for directions and she points ahead to an open ground-floor doorway a few metres away, where a doctor with a stethoscope around his neck is standing. No text, no signs, no nameplates.

lx:Termin:1.de: Ich möchte gern einen Termin machen.
lx:Termin:1.sahne_en: A woman sits at her living-room table holding a phone to her ear, with an open paper appointment diary in front of her and a pen ready to note the appointment. No readable text, no logos.

lx:Termin:2.de: Haben Sie diese Woche noch einen Termin frei?
lx:Termin:2.sahne_en: At the reception desk of a small family doctor's practice, a receptionist in a plain cardigan runs her finger along a large open appointment book while a male patient leans on the counter and waits for her answer. No readable text, no signs, no logos.

lx:Termin:3.de: Ich hab um drei 'nen Termin beim Arzt.
lx:Termin:3.sahne_en: On a pavement in a Bavarian town, a woman taps her wristwatch, its hands showing almost three o'clock, and explains to a friend that she has to go, half-turned to leave. No text, no signs, no numerals on the watch face.

lx:Kilo:3.de: Uff, schon wieder zwei Kilo mehr auf der Waage.
lx:Kilo:3.sahne_en: In a simple home bathroom, a middle-aged man stands on an analog bathroom scale, looks down at the dial with a groan and holds one hand on his belly. No text, no logos, no readable digits.

lx:Kilo:4.de: – Wie viel darf's sein? – Ein Kilo Kartoffeln, bitte.
lx:Kilo:4.sahne_en: At an outdoor vegetable stall at a market in Bavaria, the vendor pours potatoes into the metal bowl of an old-fashioned hanging scale while a female customer with a cloth bag watches. No text, no signs, no price tags.

lx:Kilo:6.de: – Wie schwer ist das Paket? – Fast drei Kilo.
lx:Kilo:6.sahne_en: At a plain post office counter, a clerk in ordinary clothes places a medium cardboard parcel on a flat counter scale, and the customer on the other side waits. No text, no signs, no logos, no labels on the parcel.

lx:Uhr:1.sahne_en: A simple round wall clock hangs in a bright apartment kitchen, its hour hand pointing exactly at ten and its minute hand at twelve, with a coffee cup on the table below. No numerals on the clock face, only plain hour marks, no text.

lx:Uhr:3.sahne_en: In a small office, a man frowns as he compares his wristwatch with the round wall clock above the door, the two showing clearly different times. No numerals on either clock face, no text, no logos.

lx:Uhr:4.de: – Wie viel Uhr ist es? – Halb drei.
lx:Uhr:4.sahne_en: On a sunny street in a small Bavarian town, a woman stops an older man to ask the time, and he lifts his arm to look at his wristwatch, its hands showing half past two. No text, no signs, no numerals on the watch face.

lx:Tüte:1.sahne_en: At a supermarket checkout, the cashier holds up one empty brown paper shopping bag toward a male customer whose groceries lie on the conveyor belt. No text, no signs, no logos, no brands.

lx:Tüte:2.de: Die kleine Tüte kostet vier Euro.
lx:Tüte:2.sahne_en: At an outdoor market stall in Bavaria, the vendor holds up a small paper bag filled with almonds next to a much larger one on the table, while a customer counts coins in her palm. No text, no signs, no price tags.

lx:Tüte:5.de: Derya trägt zwei schwere Tüten nach Hause.
lx:Tüte:5.sahne_en: On a residential street of apartment buildings, a woman in a coat walks home carrying two full, heavy shopping bags, one in each hand, leaning slightly from the weight, with leeks and bread sticking out of the tops. No text, no signs, no logos.

lx:warten:1.sahne_en: In the waiting room of a family doctor's practice, several adult patients sit quietly on a row of chairs along the wall, and a receptionist at the doorway gestures politely toward a free chair for a newly arrived man. No text, no signs, no posters.

lx:warten:2.de: Ich warte schon eine halbe Stunde.
lx:warten:2.sahne_en: In a café, a woman sits alone at a table with an empty coffee cup and an empty chair opposite her, checking her wristwatch with an impatient expression. No text, no signs, no logos.

lx:warten:5.de: Josef wartet vor dem Haus auf das Taxi.
lx:warten:5.sahne_en: An older man in a coat stands on the pavement in front of an apartment building with a small suitcase beside him, looking down the street; a plain beige car is approaching in the distance. No text, no signs, no roof signs on the car.
